query:
SELECT e.r2_key
                        FROM go_entries e
                        LEFT JOIN caches c ON c.id = e.cache_id
                        WHERE e.id = $1
                            AND (
                                e.expires_at <= now()
                                OR e.cache_id IS NULL
                                OR e.generation <> c.go_generation
                            )
                        FOR UPDATE OF e SKIP LOCKED
